POSTPONED PROCEEDINGS - At the conclusion of debate on H.R. 6945, the Chair put the question on motion to recommit and by voice vote, announced the noes had prevailed. Ms. Moore (WI) demanded the yeas and nays and the Chair postponed further proceedings until a time to be announced.
The previous question on the motion to recommit was ordered pursuant to clause 2(b) of rule XIX.
Ms. Moore (WI) moved to recommit to the Committee on Ways and Means. (text: CR H1147)
The previous question was ordered pursuant to the rule.
DEBATE - The House proceeded with one hour of debate on H.R. 6945.

Rule provides for consideration of H.R. 6945, H.R. 6359 and H.J. Res. 140. The resolution provides for consideration of H.R. 6945, H.R. 6359, and H.J. Res. 140 under a closed rule with one hour of general debate and one motion to recommit on each measure.

dimensions.assessment: Affects state agencies administering TANF funds and pregnancy centers receiving or seeking state financial support.
dimensions.evidence: Nothing in this part shall be construed to prohibit a State from using a grant made under section 403 to support pregnancy centers.

dimensions.assessment: Clarifies existing administrative authority for states regarding the distribution of existing federal block grant funds.
dimensions.evidence: clarifies the authority of States to use funds for pregnancy centers, and for other purposes.

dimensions.assessment: Does not appropriate new federal funds, but permits the reallocation of existing TANF grant funds by states.
dimensions.evidence: prohibit a State from using a grant made under section 403 to support pregnancy centers.

dimensions.assessment: Amends Section 404 of the Social Security Act to explicitly prevent restrictions on state use of TANF funds for pregnancy centers.

importance_detail.rationale: The bill clarifies statutory authority allowing states to use Temporary Assistance for Needy Families (TANF) grant funds to support pregnancy centers that meet specific criteria.
